title: Prophet Adam (AS)
details: Adam (AS) was the first human created by Allah from clay. He was taught the names of all things and commanded the angels to prostrate. Iblis refused and was expelled. Adam and Hawa lived in Jannah but were sent to Earth after eating from the forbidden tree. He is the father of humanity and the first prophet.

title: Prophet Idris (Enoch) (AS)
details: Idris (AS) was the second prophet after Adam. He was known for his wisdom, truthfulness, and for being the first to use a pen for writing. Allah raised him to a high station.

title: Prophet Nuh (Noah) (AS)
details: Nuh (AS) preached for 950 years. He built an Ark by Allah's command to save the believers and pairs of animals from the Great Flood that destroyed his disbelieving people.

title: Prophet Hud (AS)
details: Hud (AS) was sent to the people of 'Ad, who were known for their physical strength and tall buildings. They rejected his message and were destroyed by a fierce wind.

title: Prophet Salih (AS)
details: Salih (AS) was sent to the people of Thamud. As a sign, Allah brought a miraculous she-camel out of a rock. The people killed the camel and were subsequently destroyed by an earthquake.

title: Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) (AS)
details: The 'Friend of Allah' and patriarch of prophets. He survived being thrown into a fire by Nimrod, built the Kaaba with Ismail, and is the father of Ismail and Ishaq.

title: Prophet Lut (Lot) (AS)
details: Lut (AS) was a nephew of Ibrahim and was sent to the people of Sodom. They were destroyed for their corruption and immorality after rejecting his warnings.

title: Prophet Ismail (Ishmael) (AS)
details: The eldest son of Ibrahim, born to Hajar. He helped his father build the Kaaba and is the ancestor of Prophet Muhammad (SAW).

title: Prophet Ishaq (Isaac) (AS)
details: The second son of Ibrahim, born to Sarah. He is the ancestor of the Children of Israel.

title: Prophet Yaqub (Jacob) (AS)
details: The son of Ishaq and father of Yusuf. He is also known as 'Israel', and his twelve sons became the founders of the twelve tribes of Israel.

title: Prophet Yusuf (Joseph) (AS)
details: The son of Yaqub, known for his extraordinary beauty and the gift of interpreting dreams. After being sold into slavery by his brothers, he eventually became a high official in Egypt.

title: Prophet Ayyub (Job) (AS)
details: Ayyub (AS) is the symbol of patience. He was tested with the loss of his wealth, health, and family, but remained steadfast in his devotion to Allah.

title: Prophet Shuayb (AS)
details: Sent to the people of Madyan, who were known for cheating in weights and measures. They rejected him and were destroyed by a great blast.

title: Prophet Musa (Moses) (AS)
details: The prophet who led the Children of Israel out of Egypt. He received the Torah and spoke directly with Allah at Mount Sinai.

title: Prophet Harun (Aaron) (AS)
details: The brother of Musa and his supporter in his mission to Pharaoh. He was known for his eloquence.

title: Prophet Dhul-Kifl (Ezekiel) (AS)
details: A prophet mentioned in the Quran as being among the patient and righteous. He was known for his commitment to his covenants.

title: Prophet Dawud (David) (AS)
details: A prophet and king who received the Zabur (Psalms). He defeated Jalut (Goliath) and was known for his beautiful voice and devotion.

title: Prophet Sulayman (Solomon) (AS)
details: The son of Dawud, he was a prophet and king granted power over the winds, jinn, and the ability to speak to animals.

title: Prophet Ilyas (Elijah) (AS)
details: Sent to the people of Baalbek in modern-day Lebanon, he called them to worship Allah alone and reject the idol Baal.

title: Prophet Al-Yasa (Elisha) (AS)
details: A prophet who succeeded Ilyas and continued his mission among the Children of Israel.

title: Prophet Yunus (Jonah) (AS)
details: Known as 'Dhun-Nun', he was swallowed by a whale after leaving his people in anger. He repented inside the whale and was saved.

title: Prophet Zakariyya (Zechariah) (AS)
details: A prophet and the father of Yahya. He was the guardian of Maryam and prayed for a child in his old age, which Allah granted.

title: Prophet Yahya (John) (AS)
details: The son of Zakariyya, known for his wisdom, piety, and asceticism. He confirmed the message of Isa (AS).

title: Prophet Isa (Jesus) (AS)
details: Born miraculously to Maryam, he performed many miracles and received the Injil (Gospel). Islam teaches he was raised to heaven and will return.

title: Prophet Muhammad (SAW)
details: The last and final messenger of Allah. He received the Quran and completed the message of Islam for all mankind.
